terms.label: Albedo Feature
terms.definition: Geographic area distinguished by amount of reflected light

terms.label: Astronaut-named features
terms.definition: Lunar features at or near Apollo landing sites

terms.label: Cavus, cavi
terms.definition: Hollows, irregular steep-sided depressions usually in arrays or clusters

terms.label: Collum, colli
terms.definition: "Neck"; the region connecting two lobes of a bilobed asteroid

terms.label: Farrum, farra
terms.definition: Pancake-like structure, or a row of such structures

terms.label: Flexus, flexūs
terms.definition: A very low curvilinear ridge with a scalloped pattern

terms.label: Flumen, flumina
terms.definition: Channel on Titan that might carry liquid

terms.label: Fretum, freta
terms.definition: Strait, a narrow passage of liquid connecting two larger areas of liquid

terms.label: Insula, insulae
terms.definition: Island (islands), an isolated land area (or group of such areas) surrounded by, or nearly surrounded by, a liquid area (sea or lake)

terms.label: Labyrinthus, labyrinthi
terms.definition: Complex of intersecting valleys or ridges.

terms.label: Lacuna, lacunae
terms.definition: Irregularly shaped depression on Titan having the appearance of a dry lake bed

terms.label: Lacus, lacūs
terms.definition: "Lake" or small plain; on Titan, a "lake" or small, dark plain with discrete, sharp boundaries

terms.label: Linea, lineae
terms.definition: A dark or bright elongate marking, may be curved or straight

terms.label: Lingula, lingulae
terms.definition: Extension of plateau having rounded lobate or tongue-like boundaries

terms.label: Lobus, lobi
terms.definition: One of two lobes of a contact binary asteroid

terms.label: Mare, maria
terms.definition: “Sea”; on the Moon, low albedo, relatively smooth plain, generally of large extent; on Mars, dark albedo areas of no known geological significance; on Titan, large expanses of dark materials thought to be liquid hydrocarbons

terms.label: Mensa, mensae
terms.definition: A flat-topped prominence with cliff-like edges

terms.label: Oceanus, oceani
terms.definition: A very large dark area on the moon

terms.label: Patera, paterae
terms.definition: An irregular crater, or a complex one with scalloped edges

terms.label: Regio, regiones
terms.definition: A large area marked by reflectivity or color distinctions from adjacent areas, or a broad geographic region

terms.label: Satellite Feature
terms.definition: A feature that shares the name of an associated feature. For example, on the Moon the craters referred to as "Lettered Craters" are classified in the gazetteer as "Satellite Features."

terms.label: Serpens, serpentes
terms.definition: Sinuous feature with segments of positive and negative relief along its length

terms.label: Sinus, sinūs
terms.definition: "Bay"; small plain; on Titan, bays within seas or lakes of liquid hydrocarbons

terms.label: Virga, virgae
terms.definition: A streak or stripe of color
